chunks: Musa ibn al-Qasim narrated from ʿAli al-Jarami, from them both, from Ibn Muskan, from al-Halabi, from Abu ʿAbdillah عليه السلام, who said:
I said to him: A man performed tawaf and did not know whether he had completed seven circuits or eight. He said: He should perform two rakʿahs.
ai.seo_question: What should someone do if they doubt whether their tawaf was seven circuits or eight?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning doubt in the number of circuits of tawaf. When a person is uncertain whether he completed seven or eight circuits, the Imam عليه السلام instructs that he perform two rakʿahs.
